services.name: Helicopter Tours
services.desc: Looking for reliable and experienced helicopter maintenance in Traverse City or across Northern Michigan? At 45 North’s TC Helicopters, we provide high-quality maintenance, inspection, and repair services for a wide range of helicopter makes and models - including Airbus, Eurocopter, Bell, and MD Helicopters. With more than 25 years of experience serving the aviation industry, our team of factory-trained and FAA-certified technicians delivers meticulous workmanship, personalized service, and the highest safety standards. Whether you operate privately, commercially, or under Part 135, you can count on TC Helicopters to keep your aircraft mission-ready. Based at Cherry Capital Airport (KTVC)
